E: Dash (grants temporary immunity)
Q: Kick (deals damaged to downed players)
F: Parry (depending on option, stuns enemy player or heals you)

games.name: 🏥 Hospital Map! | Blox Hunt v3.2.0
games.desc:
Check out Blox Hunt's sequel, Hide N' Find! https://www.roblox.com/games/4653158113/Hide-N-Find

Blox Hunt is a hide and seek style game with a twist: you become objects to hide in with the surroundings. 

Players are randomly selected to become Hiders and Seekers. The Hiders must blend in with the environment in order to avoid capture from the Seekers. If caught, they become a Seeker. The game ends if every Hider becomes a Seeker or the time runs out.
